description: On the bed in front of you, there’s a white bulb-shaped stand on a square base and a white cup-shaped piece beside it. The left hand slides in to steady the stand as a left-hand object, while the right hand reaches to grasp the cup as a right-hand object, lifts it upward and over the bulb, then lowers it to fit onto the stand before the right hand lets go and both hands pull back.
